dataset_name: CMS 2008-2010 Data Entrepreneurs' Synthetic Public Use File Sample 1

source.license_or_terms: CMS public use data; consult CMS Data Disclaimer and User Agreement

source_shape.native_format: CSV files distributed as ZIP archives

sde_bench_run.evaluation_scope: CMS Sample 1, 2008 beneficiary summary joined to 2008-2010 inpatient claims; internal synthetic-only split
sde_bench_run.export_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m sde_bench de-synpuf-export --beneficiary data/public_raw/de_synpuf/DE1_0_2008_Beneficiary_Summary_File_Sample_1.csv --inpatient data/public_raw/de_synpuf/DE1_0_2008_to_2010_Inpatient_Claims_Sample_1.csv --out-dir reports/public_benchmarks/de_synpuf --format jsonl
sde_bench_run.evaluate_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m sde_bench evaluate --real reports/public_benchmarks/de_synpuf/reference.jsonl --synthetic reports/public_benchmarks/de_synpuf/synthetic.jsonl --source reports/public_benchmarks/de_synpuf/source.jsonl --target diagnosis_group --sensitive sex,race --json-out reports/public_benchmarks/de_synpuf/report.json --md-out reports/public_benchmarks/de_synpuf/report.md

interpretation_notes: DE-SynPUF is fully synthetic; this benchmark uses an internal split because no real reference table is redistributed here.
The current adapter evaluates inpatient claims only; outpatient, carrier, and prescription event tables can be added as later claims-domain extensions.
ICD-9-CM diagnosis fields are evaluated with icd9_format_validity; ICD-10 validity is not applicable for this claims sample.
